property_summary: For any call parameters, C.onERC721Received(...) (the reference) always returns the ERC721TokenReceiver.onERC721Received.selector, while the mutant returns 0x01ffc9a7 instead.
change_summary: Replace the return value selector with a different bytes4 constant (e.g., the supportsInterface selector) to make onERC721Received return a different value.
